## Runs 6 + 7 — `sdh-spot-check` pair at D = 0 (electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²)

**Raw:** run 6 (electron, 0→10 T; 50 mT below 1 T, 10 mT above) shows strong SdH already below 1 T, developing into deep near-zero minima above ~4 T (QH-like waveform). Run 7 (hole, 10→0.3 T, 20 mT) shows slower, beat-like oscillations, onset 0.71 T. Neither channel railed (max 12% of the 5 kΩ full scale); T_sample 1.17–1.29 K throughout.

**Electron read (run 6, F_L = 33.1 T at the run-5 calibration).** FFT on the clean 10 mT grid only (the 0.3–1 T leg is 50 mT — aliased, excluded): dominant **f₁ = 7.3 T** carrying a long harmonic comb (2×…18× — sawtooth waveform, not extra pockets), and a **B-window split** that flips the spectrum: 1–3.2 T is the 7.3 T comb; 3.2–10 T is dominated by **32.9 T ≈ F_L**. Model overlay (`fs_count_b0`, n = +3.2×10¹²): ABAB light = **7.31 T** — the measured f₁ at global scale 1.00 — heavy = 25.78 T, ABCA singleton = 33.1 T. The heavy tone is **not resolved as a distinct peak**: it sits between the 3×/4× comb members (21.9/29.2 T) with δF ≈ 1.1–1.6 T at those onsets — separation ~3.5 T ≈ 2δF, marginal on this record. The 32.9 T tone strengthening with B relative to f₁ is the breakdown/sum signature (investigation Verify: F_L-tone origin — ABAB inter-block breakdown is symmetry-allowed and lands exactly at f₁+f₂ = F_L), but on one density it is degenerate with an ABCA singleton over a coexisting lower-density domain. Onset: the carrying tone is **censored at the fine grid's low edge (1.0 T)** — the true onset is below it and unmeasured (the coarse leg aliases).

**Hole read (run 7, F_L = 12.4 T).** Tones {4.7, 6.6} + 8.5 + **12.3 ≈ F_L**; model ABAB hole pair at n = −1.2×10¹² is **5.86/6.54 T** — the measured 6.6 sits on the heavy branch, 4.7 within ~1δF (0.77 T at best; 1.1 T at its own onset) of the light branch; measured sum 11.3 ≈ 0.91·F_L, and 12.3 ≈ F_L is again the sum-tone position. This is the documented near-CNP balanced-pair exception regime, and the hole side is reach-limited (|n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² at TG −0.3 V) — **consistent-with ABAB, not decisive**.

**Take.** Both signs are consistent-with a two-pocket read: a resolved light pocket on the model's ABAB curve plus an F_L tone at the allowed breakdown-sum position. ABCA is *not* excluded on run 6 alone (the F_L tone could be a singleton over a 7.3 T domain). The discriminator is the **n-trajectory**: over n = 1.5→3.2×10¹² the ABAB light orbit doubles+ (2.0→7.3 T, partition 0.13→0.22) while any fixed-domain tone stays put and F_L-family tones track (h/4e)·n → **fan on the electron side** (density reach 3.2×10¹² where templates separate; hole side caps at 1.27×10¹² inside the exception regime). Blocking design input per `landau-fan` step 1: B_lo must be the *measured* onset and the electron onset is censored at 1.0 T → a ~25 min low-field extension (1.05→0.30 T, 3 mT) pins it before the fan commits.

# Runs 6 + 7 — sdh-spot-check pair at D = 0: raw Rxx(B), per-tone onsets, FFT in 1/B vs F_L
from hera.analysis import open_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def load(rid):
    r = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); o = np.argsort(B)
    amp = r.meta["instruments"]["sr1"]["snapshot"]["parameters"]["amplitude"]["value"]
    ib = amp / r.meta["measurement_config"]["bias_resistor"]          # 10 nA
    return B[o], (r.col("sr1_X") / 1.0 / ib)[o], ib                   # sr1 gain = 1

# model references (fs_count_b0, run-5 calibration densities; computed this session)
MODEL = {6: dict(FL=33.09, abab=(7.31, 25.78), lbl="run 6 — electron n=+3.2e12"),
         7: dict(FL=12.41, abab=(5.86, 6.54),  lbl="run 7 — hole n=−1.2e12")}
CLEAN_BLO = {6: 1.00, 7: 0.30}   # run 6: 50 mT below 1 T (aliased) — clean grid starts at 1 T

fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(13, 11))
for j, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    B, R, ib = load(rid); t = MODEL[rid]
    blo = CLEAN_BLO[rid]; m = B >= blo
    axes[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.5); axes[0, j].set_title(f"{t['lbl']}: raw Rxx(B)")
    axes[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); axes[0, j].set_ylabel("Rxx (Ω)")

    on = sdh_onset(R[m], B[m], r_full_scale=50e-6 / ib)               # sens 50 uV
    print(f"=== {t['lbl']} (analysis window B >= {blo} T) ===")
    print(on.summary())

    pf = np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5); dR = R[m] - np.polyval(pf, B[m])
    axes[1, j].plot(B[m], dR, lw=0.5)
    axes[1, j].set_title("ΔRxx (deg-5 B-space background removed)"); axes[1, j].set_xlabel("B (T)")

    ax = axes[2, j]
    win = [(max(on.onset_b, blo), 10.0, "-")]
    if rid == 6:
        win += [(1.0, 3.2, "--"), (3.2, 10.0, ":")]                   # B-window split (F_L-tone origin check)
    for lo, hi, st in win:
        f, spec = sdh_fft(R[m][:, None], B[m], b_range=(lo, hi), bg_degree=5, log=False)
        sp = spec[0] / spec[0][f > 2].max()
        ax.plot(f, sp, st, lw=1, label=f"{lo:.1f}–{hi:.1f} T")
    ax.axvline(t["FL"], color="k", lw=1); ax.text(t["FL"], 1.02, "F_L", ha="center")
    for fa in t["abab"]:
        ax.axvline(fa, color="tab:red", ls="--", lw=1, alpha=0.6)
    ax.set_xlim(0, t["FL"] * 1.6); ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
    ax.set_title(f"FFT in 1/B (black F_L = {t['FL']} T; red dashed model ABAB pair)")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 3c: low-field onset extension, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹², B 1.05 → 0.30 T

> **05:29** · sdh-spot-check low-B extension: electron n=+3.2e12 D=0, (Vtg,Vbg)=(+0.9836,+1.1661); B 1.05->0.30 T, 3 mT, 251 pts; sr1 2 uV; ends 0.3 T gates at spot · **ETA ~05:59** (≈30 min)

The fan's B_lo must be the **measured** onset (`landau-fan` step 1, lever 1), and run 6's carrying tone (7.3 T — the model's ABAB light orbit at this density, scale 1.00) is **censored at the fine grid's low edge (1.0 T)**; below 1 T run 6 sampled at 50 mT — aliased for a 7.3 T tone (period 13 mT at 0.3 T). B_lo drives the fan's row count (rows ∝ 1/B_lo, ≈ 90 → 240 rows over onset 1.0 → 0.4 T at ~2 min/row), so this ~30 min extension prices directly into hours of fan time. Grid: 3 mT uniform, descending 1.05 → 0.30 T (251 pts) — Nyquist covers the 2×7.3 T harmonic even at the 0.3 T bottom edge; grid-change reproduction also retires run 6's sub-1 T censored tones (3.0/4.2/5.1/9.5 T) as aliases or confirms them real. Sensitivity re-sized to 2 µV (200 Ω FS): run 6 shows R ≤ 57 Ω below 1.1 T at this spot — at the spot-check's 50 µV that signal sits at ~1% of full scale (coarse-ADC grainy FFT); at 2 µV it peaks at ~28% FS with 3.5× headroom. Preconditions: handoff state (B ≈ 0, T base, Si 0). Chaining: pre-position 0 → 1.05 T (blocking, ~7.7 min), sweep down, **end at 0.30 T with gates at the spot — exactly where the fan starts**. Checkpoint: first rows via `hera-watch` (signal in range, leakage, T); abort there if railed.

# === SdH spot check, electron side — LOW-FIELD EXTENSION (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 1.05 -> 0.30 T, 3 mT ===
# Pins the fan's B_lo (landau-fan step 1 lever 1): run 6's carrying tone (7.3 T) is censored at the fine
# grid's low edge (1.0 T); the 50 mT leg below 1 T is aliased. Grid-change reproduction retires the
# sub-1 T censored tones (3.0/4.2/5.1/9.5 T) for free.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)   # run-5 calibration
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set): handoff state — base T, B = 0, Si 0 ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff state), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- descending grid 1.05 -> 0.30 T, 3 mT uniform (Nyquist covers 2x7.3 T at the 0.3 T bottom edge) ---
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(1.05, 0.2999, -0.003), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Sensitivity: run 6 has R <= 57 Ohm below 1.1 T at this spot -> 2 uV = 200 Ohm FS at 10 nA (peak ~28 % FS,
# 3.5x headroom); the 50 uV spot-check scale leaves this signal at ~1 % FS (coarse-ADC grainy FFT).
sr1.sensitivity(2e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron LOW-B EXTENSION: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 1.05 -> 0.30 T, 3 mT, sr1 2 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side LOW-B extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; '
              f'(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 1.05 -> 0.30 T uniform-B 3 mT; pins the fan B_lo; '
              f'cal run 5: ratio 0.773, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)
magnet.field(1.05)   # blocking pre-position, ~7.7 min from 0 T (recipe step 4: the set call is the settle)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# End state: B = 0.30 T, gates at the spot — the fan starts here. No park.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
